added_public_definition.description: Transfer a development AppInstance to another app-dev Node.

sqlite-source-path.description: Optional SQLite database path on the source

reviewed_contract.numeric_target: Current signature accepts an explicit positive numeric resource ID; generic prompting must not silently change identifier semantics.
reviewed_contract.instance_transfer: Current accepted ORB-245: explicit positive numeric instance and destination Node IDs; optional name and selected SQLite path remain Gateway-validated inputs. Transfer preserves identity, source state and owned runtime/environment/Route lifecycle, uses independent destination checkout, allows same/cross-Cluster app-dev placement and excludes production/standalone/same-Node moves. Retain pre-cutover source authority, forward-only post-cutover retry and exact cleanup outcomes; no remote work in CLI.
reviewed_contract.transfer_force_consent: Existing --force explicitly confirms transfer downtime and old-placement deletion; it is consent, not a separate safety override. Preserve default-No interactive confirmation and instance.confirmation_required/status1 on valid unconfirmed automation. Restoration requires --force for JSON/noninteractive input and removes JSON-as-consent; do not add --yes or apply instance:destroy force semantics.
reviewed_contract.transfer_json_contract: Preserve one final JSON object with id,node_id,name,checkout_path,domain,transfer,request_id; it is not a stream or full AppInstance DTO. Preserve transfer progress/cleanup fields, request correlation, redaction and gateway.invalid_response on missing transfer metadata/domain. Do not invent intermediate phases from the final transfer response.

implementation_gaps.transfer_json_implies_consent: Current confirmed() treats --json as consent and current help/docs/tests repeat that behavior. This violates machine-mode separation and is an implementation GAP, never a compliance exception. Require existing --force in JSON/noninteractive mode; preserve default-No interaction and no-write refusal.
implementation_gaps.legacy_prompt_calls: Command or shared family helper uses Symfony ask/choice/confirm instead of the restored prompt primitives.
implementation_gaps.transfer_target_confirmation: Current transfer confirmation describes downtime/deletion but omits the selected source instance and destination identities. Shared prompt adoption must name the subject and effect while retaining explicit IDs and default-No.
implementation_gaps.shared_gateway_wait: GatewayCommand send/sendOrThrow blocks without a shared visible wait indicator. Slow-request paths need truthful terminal liveness; fast reads may not need a progress surface.

governance_drift.description: Accepted ADR0066 still says no HTTP/CLI/SDK transfer surface and verification omits instance:transfer, while accepted ORB245 and current main expose it. Separate inherited product-governance drift; does not block inventory observation, justify an exception, remove the command or authorize architecture changes. Root routes ADR wording at family preflight.
